subject: general
question: Four letter-clusters have been given out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/73e690c12a66adaf209adf0b1ff008bb704c48783bd537b818e9d442fb16b230.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 
• QSUWY → Q + 2 = S; S + 2 = U; U + 2 = W; W + 2 = Y
 
• GIKMO → G + 2 = I; I + 2 = K; K + 2 = M; M + 2 = O 
 
• **PRTVY → P + 2 = R; R + 2 = T; T + 2 = V; V + 3 = Y**
 
• ACEGI → A + 2 = C; C + 2 = E; E + 2 = G; G + 2 = I

Hence, '**PRTVY**' is the odd one out.
